plugin.name: layer-popup-focus
plugin._long: Gives keyboard focus to menus that grab input from layer surfaces without keyboard focus (e.g. lxqt-panel's menus), which Wayfire 0.11 leaves unfocused. Prototype, untested.

option.name: clients
option._long: Space-separated process names whose layer-surface popups get keyboard focus. Empty applies it to every client.
